integrity: Standalone deterministic Python integer checker covers all upward-labelled partial orders on 4 through 7 elements; no external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Finite poset-size cutoff and isomorphism classification for |P|<=7 only. Computer-assisted exhaustive proof; the seven-element witness and polytope adjacency characterizations belong to prior literature. Historical priority of the minimality and uniqueness statements is provisional.
title: The unique seven-point diameter obstruction for order and chain polytopes
